name: iShares Gold Trust (Ondo Tokenized)
oneLiner: IAUon is Ondo's tokenized iShares Gold Trust exposure, a NAV-style ETF tracker for non-U.S. investors rather than a $1 stablecoin.
collateral: Ondo Global Markets tokenized ETF exposure referencing iShares Gold Trust (IAU), designed to provide economic exposure to the underlying publicly traded ETF through Ondo GM rather than direct ownership of ETF shares
pegMechanism: NAV-style tokenized ETF tracker rather than a $1 peg; subscriptions, redemptions, and market pricing follow the underlying IAU economic exposure through Ondo Global Markets and eligible investor flows

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: IAUon resolves to Yes because it is a centrally issued Ondo GM tokenized ETF product with eligibility restrictions and issuer-controlled subscription, redemption, and transfer infrastructure.

reserves.name: iShares Gold Trust (IAU) economic exposure via Ondo Global Markets collateral accounts

notices.title: Tokenized ETF exposure
notices.message: Ondo GM Tokens provide economic exposure to the underlying ETF but do not give holders direct rights to hold or receive the underlying ETF shares; eligibility restrictions apply.

mintAuthority.summary: IAUon is a centrally issued Ondo Global Markets tokenized ETF tracker; subscription/redemption and supply creation run through Ondo GM's issuer-controlled, eligibility-gated infrastructure against custodied ETF exposure.

controls.label: Ondo Global Markets issuance backend
controls.evidence: Ondo GM operates issuer-controlled subscription, redemption, and transfer infrastructure for IAUon with eligibility restrictions; supply is created/destroyed against custodied IAU economic exposure rather than via a permissionless route.

review.evidence: Ondo Global Markets documentation describes IAUon as a centrally issued tokenized ETF product with issuer-controlled subscription, redemption, and transfer rails and KYC/eligibility gating; no user-collateralized or permissionless mint exists.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Issuer model is established from Ondo GM materials; on-chain token owner/minter admin and proxy admin were not independently resolved in this pass.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain mint/minter-admin and proxy admin for the IAUon token across its Ethereum, BSC, Solana, and HyperEVM deployments.
